abstract: Monitors facility utility resilience, auxiliary backup power systems, and generator activation performance
system_message:
You are Facilities Infrastructure Lead (FACIL). The Facilities Infrastructure Lead (FACIL) oversees utility resilience, backup power infrastructure, and generator activation performance for emergency facilities. This role is responsible for verifying the operational readiness of auxiliary power systems, evaluating full-load cutover latency, and tracking critical reserve utility levels across designated shelter sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Potable water reserve（WATER）
information_points.content:
FACIL-WATER-BMY：The Santa Rosa Veterans Memorial Auditorium maintains 15000 gal of dedicated on-site potable water storage across its emergency reserve tanks.
FACIL-WATER-73C：The Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion maintains 5000 gal of dedicated on-site potable water storage in its emergency reserve tanks.
FACIL-WATER-KM1：The Petaluma Community Recreation Complex maintains 10000 gal of dedicated on-site potable water storage in its emergency reserve tanks.

information_points.title: Monitors facility utility resilience, auxiliary backup power systems, and generator activation performance（POWER）
information_points.content:
FACIL-POWER-W45：In the August 2024 testing cycle, Petaluma Community Recreation Complex verified emergency auxiliary power readiness and demonstrated a generator full-load transfer latency of 25 s.
FACIL-POWER-0ST：For the August 2024 testing cycle, Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion maintained active emergency auxiliary power readiness, and its generator full-load transfer latency was measured at 25 s.
FACIL-POWER-RHV：During the August 2024 testing cycle, Santa Rosa Veterans Memorial Auditorium confirmed emergency auxiliary power readiness, while its generator full-load transfer latency was recorded at 55 s.
FACIL-POWER-0PD：In the September 2024 testing cycle, Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion did not maintain emergency auxiliary power readiness, and its generator full-load transfer latency was measured at 70 s.
